sources.name: arXiv API
sources.outcome: Retrieved and locally date-filtered 1,438 new mathematics records in the reporting window and identified one material in-window revision.

sources.name: arXiv abstract and paper pages
sources.outcome: Selected identifiers, versions, titles, authors, event dates, abstracts, and relevant disclosure text were checked; intermittent page and cache limitations were supplemented with API metadata and inspectable paper text.

sources.name: Crossref, DOI, publisher, and artifact resolvers
sources.outcome: Four in-window publisher events and referenced computer-verification artifacts were resolved; one journal-publication event was selected.

sources.name: Independent AI-mathematics coverage
sources.outcome: Two in-window independent coverage records normalized to one AI-mathematics advance; critical reporting supplied attribution, originality, and validation caveats.

sources.name: OpenAI ten-advances technical package
sources.outcome: The overview, updated manuscript, and Lean artifacts were inspectable; the publisher is also the model developer and principal guarantor.

sources.name: Expert and independent-paper corroboration
sources.outcome: Expert commentary and independent constructions were used as qualified corroboration, not as substitutes for peer review or full proof verification.

candidate_basis.normalization_note: The two independent AI coverage records normalize to one mathematical advance.

ranking_audit.title: Linear dependence of time-frequency shifts of a Schwartz function
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Highest-ranked HA event because it directly overturns a long-standing core conjecture with an explicit, inspectable construction.

ranking_audit.title: Counterexamples to Schiffer's Conjecture

ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected as the strongest same-week refinement of the HRT counterexample because it identifies a sharp cardinality threshold.

ranking_audit.title: The trace-free Beurling--Ahlfors transform and the Bourgain--Brezis problem for Hodge systems
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for its direct resolution of a major endpoint HA problem and its reusable singular-integral mechanism.

ranking_audit.title: Gabor Frames of Totally Positive Functions: A Complete Characterization
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for a clean if-and-only-if solution to a prominent Gabor-frame classification problem.

ranking_audit.title: A positive solution to the generalized Busemann--Petty problem with subspace dimensions $2$ and $3$
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected because it closes the outstanding low-dimensional section cases of a foundational Radon-transform problem.

ranking_audit.title: Sharp spectral-cluster restriction bounds for orthonormal systems
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected because the in-window revision upgrades a central restriction result to sharp summability across all cases.

ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for a sharp counterexample phenomenon linking maximal estimates, incidence geometry, and dispersive evolution.

ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for a direct, quantitatively sharp oscillatory-integral theorem tied to a standing conjecture.

ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for connecting arithmetic structure to endpoint and long-time dispersive estimates.

ranking_audit.title: Fourier dimension of Mandelbrot cascades on planar curves

ranking_audit.title: Pointwise endpoint limits for nonlocal operators

ranking_audit.title: Sharp $L^2$ Estimates for $(2+1)$-dimensional oscillatory integral operators with homogeneous binomial phases

ranking_audit.title: The period-index conjecture is false

ranking_audit.title: A solution to Morrey's problem in $\mathbb{R}^{2\times m}$

url_validation.note: The two restricted pages returned HTTP 403 to curl but were inspectable through indexed or browser retrieval, so their links were retained.

warnings: The requested model identifier was copied exactly, but the runtime did not expose an independently verifiable actual model identifier.
Most selected mathematics items are unrefereed preprints; their claims were checked against primary metadata and manuscripts, not independently proof-verified.
Revision discovery through arXiv date queries is not exhaustive; explicit version histories and DOI metadata supplemented the weekly sweep.

The selected AI-math package is an interested-party release. Independent reporting raised attribution and originality concerns, and the public materials do not expose the full problem pool, failures, prompts, trajectories, orchestration, or precise human interventions.
The OpenAI and Scientific American pages returned HTTP 403 to curl, but both were inspectable through indexed or browser retrieval and their links were retained.
The report push is pending at content-log finalization; a later append-only publication record and structured-log update must record the actual push result.
Before the report commit, local main was already two commits ahead of origin/main; direct publication will also publish those existing local commits.
